basis: Owner-authorized definitive retirement. Local journey acceptance is not final Foundation, CI or release acceptance.

journeys.cutover: BusinessContextController@start serves only the unified SPA. The previous Context creation presentation is unreachable. The existing creation key, SQL writer, transaction and non-JSON redirects are preserved. Successful creation continues to canonical Goals in the same unified SPA document; this is not acceptance of the whole advertiser group.

journeys.spaBoundary: Canonical editor and saved review use the shared Vue Router; Laravel retains the existing writer and scoped contextual reads
journeys.cutover: Canonical HTML routes contain only the unified shell and no business projection. The former Business/Goals Vue renderer and locale adapter are deleted; behavior tests exercise the actual SPA editor. Existing opt-in proof URLs reuse this renderer and shared entry; their production flag is not enabled. Business context, sources and account/security destinations remain native boundaries pending their cutover. Final Foundation, remote CI and B/C/device acceptance remain separate.

journeys.journey: Edit classified business name/type, request explicit authority, replace target markets, and replace or clear Current Intent with independent drafts and CAS review

journeys.cutover: BusinessContextController no longer renders a legacy page. The former Pages/Business/Context renderer is moved into the SPA feature without any legacy imports; its component requirements remain tested. Existing native redirects are preserved; JSON commands acknowledge the same original writers. Memory-only Workspace/form drafts survive same-document suspension and clear on terminal document closure. Sources/Object Purpose and authentication/internal destinations remain pending; this is not complete advertiser or final Foundation/CI acceptance.

journeys.journey: Declare exact finite advertising-object purpose, review canonical temporal history, correct/replace/withdraw with explicit DTM/Intent references and an immutable unresolved command
journeys.spaBoundary: Canonical list/detail and same-document business-context links in the shared SPA; existing raw JSON projections and 201 writers remain canonical
journeys.cutover: Legacy Business/ObjectPurposes rendering is removed. The same view/editor now use official Vue Router and the shared typed client/transport. Unknown outcomes lock replacement until an explicit exact-original retry is acknowledged; terminal closure clears document memory. The original SQL owner/membership/freshness predicate, temporal writer, receipt fingerprint and Meta-only HTTP admission remain unchanged. Generic canonical object identity is not reduced to Meta. Final Foundation/CI, source/provider/auth/internal migration and B/C/device gates remain separate.

journeys.journey: Declare and manage exact Source scopes, connect/discover/select/disconnect five providers, renew Google/Snapchat, request and inspect canonical reports, recover original uncertain commands and return safely from OAuth
journeys.spaBoundary: Canonical /workspaces/:workspace uses the existing unified Vue Router, typed client and transport. Provider callbacks, report workers and Google CSV stay on Laravel.
journeys.cutover: WorkspaceController@show serves only SpaPage; Business/Sources, Workspaces/Show and their eight dead Source components are deleted. All five native OAuth/discovery/selection, exact Source/workspace isolation, original-command recovery, reports through real canonical workers, Google hierarchy/CSV and X campaigns are browser-tested against isolated Laravel with synthetic native providers. Source drafts and unresolved commands are session/account-bound and never replay automatically. Meta bootstrap reuses its exact immutable configuration Source under the same existing fresh-owner/A003 gates. No SessionAuthority, WorkspaceContext, RLS, N1 or shared transport change. Local journey evidence is not live provider approval, production, native device/BFCache or final Foundation/CI acceptance.
